method: Read current index canonical archive, published aggregate and player catalog. Compare missing curated IDs to every exact-total result on the same course; retain player, clocks, links and source bindings separately.
limitations: Equal time alone does not prove same player, race attempt, WR standing or date. Multiple competitors can tie. No unmatched ID automatically restored or dropped.
Player candidate lookup uses exact profile name, ID or declared alias only; missing mappings remain unresolved. Similar names and Sucha aliases are not guessed.
Source message binding can indicate repost or related evidence, not necessarily original race proof. Raw URL equality is conservative and does not normalize video IDs.
Existing verification labels retained as data; no fresh image/video availability, playback, live Discord coverage or deployment certified.
This crosswalk covers community-wr canonical entries absent by exact curated ID, not all unrepresented performances or all server sources.
